events: Validate strictly increasing sequence in recorded order, then stable-sort by (monotonicMs, sequence) for cross-producer event association; other streams still require nondecreasing time

summary.all: All observed valid values; per-field nulls remain missing
summary.steady: Only context-confirmed steady frames; unknown context is excluded

experience.scope: full only; cost values are null with reason
experience.fractions: 0..1 except normalizedGpuLoad and measuredGpuBusyFraction may exceed 1
experience.windows: Contiguous steady 1 s windows; no gap crossing

cost.viewports: role:instanceId; main accepts native costs approximately aligned +/-2 frames with unknown source/freshness; other viewports require fresh source-confirmed readings; GPU aggregate excludes unconfirmed sources
cost.phases: B0-B4 wall intervals; association only, never CPU busy time
cost.mainViewportSpikes: Cost candidates cover +/-2 frames; no exact phase/cause attribution; distributions, budgets, trends and DECISION-348 remain available

summary.budgets: budget_checks is the single owner of applicability, reason, thresholds and tier. Consumers filter emitted fields; G10 uses the grouped distance-table tier without its own metric list or comparison.
summary.coverage: Per-stream state and rows, per-field non-null fraction; 0..1 or null
summary.validity: Only affected fields disabled; hardware loss does not disable engine metrics
summary.median: Prior valid steady frames in the same scene and caliber; nonsteady/gap rows do not enter or clear the window; scene/effective quality/output-size changes reset it
summary.deepen: Runnable powershell.exe command with actual DeepenEntry and entry-specific DiagnosticTool; source poseArgs/conditions retained; no placeholder runner state
summary.inputStamp: Current calc, schema, file size/mtime, budget snapshot and current context rules; no checksum
summary.judgement: Per-session pain counts and required checks; scene confirmation keeps worse pain counts and one real rate sample. Only round route+travel totals judge light rate. Missing required facts leave acceptance unjudged while measured cost changes remain available.
summary.waits: Whole-session command endpoints; missing endpoints stay missing. Startup targets are unjudged for every session until the actual double-click launcher start is recorded.
summary.streamFacts: Source event count/latest snapshot for stream.tileChanged, bake.cache, map.arrival; no duplicate stream-statistics owner

curves.levels: Fixed bucket limits from perf_curves.CURVE_LIMITS; consumers select an existing level, never reaggregate raw streams
curves.buckets: fromMs,toMs,frames then series Mean/Max pairs; valid measured values only, missing remains null with seriesReasons
curves.fps: Mean=valid frame count/valid dt sum*1000; Max=1000/min valid dt; full scope only
curves.normalizedGpuLoad: Same sample utilization*clock/maxClock via perf_model.normalized_gpu_load; full scope only
curves.hotframes: Analyzer-selected heavy-or-worse rows, capped by perf_curves.HOTFRAME_LIMIT; invalid dt and phases are null; total before display cap

runJson.scene: Stable scenario identity; part of comparisonKey
runJson.exitCode: Actual process exit code or null
runJson.coverage: Named observed facts, each {observed:number,required:number}; e.g. frames, seconds, segments; all must reach requirements
runJson.diagnostic: true only for diagnostic conditions; never a baseline
runJson.note: No complete/valid/satisfied duplicate booleans; missing actual facts produce partial
runJson.launcher: Raw per-attempt script/Stopwatch and native process start/exit facts; process elapsed cannot prove a complete double-click launch is under budget. AI startup targets remain unjudged.
runJson.conditions: Frozen suite, bool travelPrefetch, routePointIds and batch logicalPauseVerified/mainThreadLongStopVerified, tuningSelectedMetrics; no runtime game toggles
runJson.roundId: Analyzer round registration identity; sourceRoot and scene plan live only in rounds.json
runJson.confirmationOf: Main session ID only for the one conditional confirmation

diagnosticsJson.location: Beside diagnostic attachments under AI runs
diagnosticsJson.attachments: Relative file paths; analyzer enforces total bytes only inside this directory; raw six files are never attachments

retention: perf_store.py constants; author root is read-only and owned by recorder
batch: Analyzer-only completed-main round registration: freeze one complete base-valid main per planned scene before assigning the round number; incomplete attempts never register. A registered round may append independent confirmation roots without replacing its main sessions, scene plan or N-1 identity. G10 only reads the latest registered round and comparison.

roundComparison.confirmation: One confirmation when a metric is near upper, a selected metric is near stop, or a pain occurs once. Main and confirmation must share complete comparison/build/environment identity and frozen conditions/budget criteria; a rerun budget tier makes the round Incomplete. Select the whole real distribution for each worse judged statistic and name its source, never combine sample counts. Per-scene light-rate source keeps its real count/duration pair; only round route+travel totals judge the light limit.
